test.title: Experts X3: the quartering leg at Hillarys, 20 to 25 mph SSW, 2 to 3 ft
test.purpose: Mike's Hillarys laps: the leg along the breakwall has the wind sea on the quarter.
lookFor: the rudder's load bar and red lamp, the yaw split (waves against rudder) along the breakwall leg
questions: How often is the rudder near its limit there, and when does it let go?
What do you do then: lean, a stroke on one side, ease off?
test.compare: Add &boat=v3 to the address for the vNext boat (sway, yaw and a rudder foil that stalls and ventilates; &rudder=large for the large blade). The Engineering instruments show the rudder, the yaw split, the drift and the wave's push.
